top.title: Gold Climbs to Two-Week High on Softer Dollar, Falling Treasury Yields After U.S. Midterms
top.summary: Gold futures rose to a two-week high supported by a weaker dollar and declining Treasury yields after the Democratic sweep of U.S. Congress raised expectations of tighter fiscal discipline.

top.title: Treasury, European Bond Yields Tumble as Markets Lifted By U.S. Democrats’ Victory
top.summary: Bond markets cheered the prospect of fiscal restraint in the U.S., as the election result could lead to political gridlock, with a Republican President and Democrat-controlled Congress.

top.title: Maersk Shares Tumble After Earnings, Guidance Disappoint
top.summary: The Danish company said severe typhoons in East Asia and the disruption to shipping from the Strait of Hormuz closure caused widespread network congestion.

top.title: AI Selloff Extends, Treasurys Gain as Blue Wave Reverberates
top.summary: Artificial-intelligence stocks continued to weaken globally as investors digested the implications of the Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections.

top.title: European Defense Stocks Under Pressure After Mixed Earnings, Midterm Results
top.summary: European defense companies were in decline after a mixed set of earnings and midterm election results that cast doubt on the extent of U.S. military spending going forward.

top.title: China Blocks $5.4 Billion SoftBank Robot Deal, Flexing Control Over AI Tech
top.summary: Beijing is seeking to keep AI data and expertise developed at home from leaking abroad.
